author: Mark Atwood
text: WONTFIX 2026-05-12 (Mark, interactive, SECOND closure — final). The 2026-05-12 reversal (open → reopened to mirror upstream comprehensively) was based on the wrong question: 'comprehensive vs curated coverage in pkix-lint-cabf?' Mark picked comprehensive but on reflection the original .8 plan still required hand-authoring Rust check_cert() predicate bodies for each lint — exactly the 'Rust transcription of someone else's policy' that Mark wants to never spend his time on (constraint articulated 2026-05-12). Even with automated zlint metadata vendoring, the predicate side stays hand-authored, so the reversal didn't actually satisfy the no-transcription stance. SUBSTANTIVE ARCHITECTURAL RESOLUTION (now ratified in AGENTS.md non-negotiable #5, three-mode policy-class model): comprehensive CA/B Forum BR coverage lives outside the workspace, in a future pkix-policy-zlint sibling adapter crate that wraps zlint at runtime (subprocess or FFI) and normalizes its findings into the workspace's Finding/Lint shape. The workspace defers to zlint's maintainers; Mark never transcribes their predicates. pkix-lint-cabf and pkix-profiles-cabf survive as a deliberately-bounded UNPRINCIPLED EXCEPTION: hand-authored small curated reference sets for the marquee CA/B Forum BR violations, explicitly labeled as such, not a template for -mozilla / -fedramp / -dod / -etsi crates. CHILDREN .8.3-.8.6 RE-WONTFIX in this session. PKIX-LINT-CABF-REFRESH scaffold stays deleted (per commit 82acfa68); no need to restore. FOLLOW-UP BEAD: a new epic for pkix-policy-* adapter crates (pkix-policy-zlint at minimum) replaces this work. Memory pkix-amgn-8-reversed-2026-05-12 SUPERSEDED by pkix-amgn-8-final-wontfix-2026-05-12.
